item.name: Story
item.cardSummary: Main progressive path with no level gate. Clear Acts on Normal and Hard for Gems, EXP, and materials, then push Mastery and Infinite on each map.
item.objective: Clear themed Story stages. Each stage has 5 Acts, a Mastery Act, and an Infinite Mode. Defend waves on Normal or Hard difficulty.
item.rewardSummary: Gems, Gold, player EXP, evolution materials, Star Mission Trait Rerolls, Mastery materials and exclusive equipment chances
item.progressionImpact: First priority for new accounts. Unlocks maps, resources, and readiness for Challenges, Expeditions, and Raids.
item.specialRules: Hard Mode adds a second first-clear reward set after Normal clears. Mastery consolidates the map pool on Hard and can drop materials or exclusive equipment. Infinite Mode is endless waves with uncapped HP scaling. Star Missions on Normal and Hard grant Trait Rerolls (up to 6 per Act across both difficulties).

item.name: Challenge
item.cardSummary: Rotating Hard Story-style stages with no level gate. Best repeatable farm for Trait Crystals, Sprites, locks, rerolls, and Gems on fixed cadences.
item.objective: Clear special Hard-mode Story stages that add Stage Effects. Regular, Daily, and Weekly challenge slots rotate on a shared global schedule.
item.rewardSummary: Trait Crystals, Sprites, Gems, Gold, Unit EXP, Player EXP, Equipment Lock/Reroll, Stat Lock/Reroll (exact bundles vary by Regular/Daily/Weekly slot)
item.progressionImpact: Efficient material farm at any account stage. Regular slots refresh often; Daily and Weekly slots pay larger bundles.
item.specialRules: Regular Challenges offer 3 choices but only 1 clear every 30 minutes. Daily Challenges reset every 24 hours. Weekly Challenges reset every 7 days. Reward tables can change; treat listed items as reward types, not permanent exact counts.

item.name: Expeditions
item.cardSummary: Unlocks at Player Level 20. Roguelike payload defense plus a dedicated Expedition Hub for long-term Gold, gear materials, and building upgrades.
item.access: Lobby Play UI, Progressive section, or the Expedition portal once unlocked.
item.objective: Escort a payload through chosen Expedition nodes, then spend run resources in the Expedition Hub on buildings such as Gold Mine, Resource Drill, Armory, Research Lab, Training Grounds, Shop, and Quest Board.
item.playersTeams: Up to 4 players; shared 14-unit placement cap (1 placement per unit brought)
item.rewardSummary: Expedition Coins, Fuel Cells, map resources (such as Cursed Timber, Lush Dirt, Aqua Shards), Equipment Scrap, Geodes, Gold, Gems, and hub crafting materials
item.progressionImpact: Core late-game farm after Story. Funds Expedition buildings, equipment rerolls/forge paths, and sustained account upgrades.
item.specialRules: Payload starts at 1,000 HP and fails the stage if it reaches 0. Three difficulties raise reward quality. Party leader chooses the node route. Hub facilities unlock more functions as they are built and upgraded.

item.name: Raid
item.cardSummary: Endgame progressive mode unlocked at Player Level 25 in guide consensus. Harder multi-act maps for Raid Tokens, totems, and exclusive drops.
item.objective: Clear difficult Raid stages with unique maps, food types, and Raid-specific rewards. Each Raid uses a three-stage structure rather than Story Acts.
item.playersTeams: Co-op focused; solo clears are possible for easier Raids with a strong evolved team
item.rewardSummary: Raid Tokens (general and map-specific), Raid Shop goods, Raid Totems, exclusive equipment, possible exclusive unit drops, Gems, and Gold
item.progressionImpact: Main endgame currency and exclusive-drop route after evolving a Story team. Spend Tokens in the matching Raid Shop.
item.specialRules: Raid Totems bought in that Raid's shop grant permanent +0.10x damage in that Raid per totem owned, up to 10 totems (x2 damage). Stage-exclusive units can have higher drop chance on harder difficulties. Spirit City is the documented Raid stage roster entry.

item.name: Tournament
item.cardSummary: Weekly competitive brackets with no level gate. Climb Solo or Duo leaderboards for Crowns, shop cosmetics, and rotating exclusives.
item.objective: Clear rotating Tournament stages under Stage Effects and score for bracket leaderboard placement using conditions such as damage dealt or enemies killed.
item.rewardSummary: Crowns for the Tournament Shop, profile cosmetics such as Unit Indicator Colors, and rotating exclusive units or skins tied to the current reset
item.progressionImpact: Seasonal competitive grind for Crowns and exclusives. Complements Story farming rather than replacing it.
item.specialRules: Resets weekly. Leaderboard standings wipe and players are reassigned into random brackets. Traits are disabled in Tournament matches according to beginner guides, so play skill matters more than trait luck. Exact exclusive rewards change each reset.

item.name: Global Tournament
item.cardSummary: Competitive Infinite-wave ladder with no level gate. Each map tracks highest wave reached across a major-update Season.
item.objective: Push any map's Infinite Mode for the highest wave score. Each map has its own active Global Tournament leaderboard.
item.playersTeams: Up to 4 players; the team shares one leaderboard slot
item.rewardSummary: Seasonal accessories, titles, and skins that rotate each major-update Season
item.progressionImpact: Long competitive push for seasonal cosmetics and Infinite records after you have a strong Infinite team.
item.specialRules: Seasons run on a per-major-update cycle. Score is based on highest wave reached, not weekly Tournament bracket points. Season reward sets change; do not treat one Season's exclusives as permanent.

item.name: Sandbox
item.cardSummary: Testing-only Play UI mode. Freely configure Yen, waves, units, enemies, modifiers, and maps with no progression farm.
item.objective: Open Sandbox, pick a map, and use the Controls panel to test unit kits, enemy interactions, and stage conditions outside normal clears.
item.rewardSummary: None. Sandbox is for testing, not account progression rewards.
item.progressionImpact: Practice and theory-crafting tool. Use it to learn kits and modifiers before spending time in Story, Challenge, Raid, or competitive modes.
item.specialRules: Controls cover Game, Units, Enemies, Modifiers, and Maps. Base stocks reaching zero do not end the match. Manually spawned enemy HP is hardcapped at 99.9M while naturally spawned enemies can scale higher.
